thesis: SLVEST has the clearest aligned positive signal in this batch after accounting for the forward valuation, but the case remains dependent on earnings and project execution that are not yet visible in the local snapshot.

Earnings or free cash flow materially miss the implied growth path.
Forward earnings estimates are revised down persistently.

Updated technical data and usable current news after 2026-08-10.
